0022600009.text: The Spurs are 0-1 and sit 15th in the West, 0.5 games back in the Southwest, with Jayden Quaintance out after knee surgery and Tobias Harris day-to-day with a calf strain and a game-time decision. The Rockets have not played a 2026-27 game yet, and Steven Adams is out with calf soreness. San Antonio won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 145-120 win at home on March 8, 2026.
